A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a 3D (13)C detected HCC-TOCY experiment that allows assignment of side-chain protons and carbons in proteins with natural abundance of 13C and 1H and with a high level of deuteration.

the (13)C detected 3D H-C-C-TOCSY is a powerful method for the assignment of side-chain H and (13) C resonances in (15)N-labeled and (13)CNMR-labeled, protonated as well as partially deuterated protein samples.

we have shown that it is feasible to use 3D H(C)(C) TOCSY for side-chain H and (13) C resonance assignment of proteins with molecular weight up to 48 kDa, which have been partially deuterated and are labeled with natural isotope abundances of (13) C and (15) N.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 3D(1)H, (13) C, (13)CO-TOCSY-HSQC experiment can be a very useful tool for the side chain H and C resonance assignments of protonated/partial deuterated (13)C- and (15)N-labeled proteins.

the use of (1)HN-(13)CO correlation in the third dimension of the (1)HN- (13)CO-(1)HN-(1)HC-TOCSY experiment is a powerful method for the side-chain (1)H, (13)H and (1)C assignment of partially deuterated, (13)N, (15)C labeled proteins.

the use of (1)HN-(13)CO-(1)HN-(1)HCC-TOCSYSY and (1)HNCO-TOCSYSYSY experiments is highly effective for the assignment of side-chain (13)C, (1)H resonances of partially deuterated (13)C labeled proteins.
